d:
The Supreme Court has allowed the lighting of the Karthigai Deepam lamp at Thiruparankundram hill in Tamil Nadu on November 24, but only as a one-time arrangement. The court has also stayed the Madras High Court's findings on the religious practice, leaving larger legal questions unresolved. The Hindu's legal correspondent explains the Supreme Court's order, the restrictions imposed and what happens next in the dispute.
Thank you for watching our video!
